description: Source code for the Nuvoton NPCX PECI driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing PECI communication interface including initialization, configuration, transfer, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: peci_npcx_check_bus_idle
methods.description: Checks if the PECI bus is idle by inspecting the status register.

methods.name: peci_npcx_wait_completion
methods.description: Waits for PECI transfer completion with timeout and error checking.

methods.name: peci_npcx_enable
methods.description: Enables PECI interface and clears status.

methods.name: peci_npcx_transfer
methods.description: Performs PECI data transfer including command, data out, and data in.

methods.name: peci_npcx_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine handling PECI transfer completion and errors.

methods.name: peci_npcx_init
methods.description: Initializes PECI device, including clock, pinctrl, and IRQ setup.
